failure_modes.policy_response: Require two matching facility identifiers and stop without projecting campus or market evidence onto a building.
Retain all claims, prohibit majority voting, and route the facility to needs_review.

policy_implications: Prioritize named buildings with operator or exact source-reference context.
Treat campus-member buildings as a distinct identity-mapping research archetype.
Exclude completed unresolved and disputed pilot records from the next general-purpose tranche.
Use regional, state, county, and operator caps so evidence yield is tested beyond the densest markets.
